787	    def _replace(
788	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
789	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None]:
790	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
791	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
792	        if record is None or record["status"] != RESTING:
793	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, [], None
794	
795	        side: str = record["side"]
796	        # The replacement trades under the target's account; the event itself
797	        # is forbidden from carrying account_id by the schema checks.
798	        account_id: str | None = record.get("account_id")
799	        is_iceberg = "display_quantity" in record
800	        display_quantity = obj.get("display_quantity")
801	        if display_quantity is None:
802	            # An omitted slice size keeps the target's original peak.
803	            display_quantity = record.get("display_quantity")
804	
805	        # Removal, matching and re-resting are one indivisible state change:
806	        # the old remainder leaves the book before the replacement arrives,
807	        # so the new order can never trade against its own previous state.
808	        self._remove_from_book(order_id, record)
809	
810	        price: int = obj["price"]
811	        remaining, trades, stp_maker = self._match(
812	            event_id, order_id, side, price, obj["quantity"], account_id
813	        )
814	
815	        new_record: dict[str, object] = {"side": side, "price": price}
816	        if account_id is not None:
817	            new_record["account_id"] = account_id
818	        stp: dict[str, object] | None = None
819	        if stp_maker is not None:
820	            # The old remainder was already removed and is not restored; the
821	            # replacement is cancelled with whatever it had left.
822	            result = (
823	                PARTIALLY_FILLED_SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED if trades else SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED
824	            )
825	            new_record["remaining"] = remaining
826	            new_record["status"] = CANCELLED
827	            stp = {
828	                "maker_order_id": stp_maker,
829	                "taker_order_id": order_id,
830	                "cancelled_quantity": remaining,
831	            }
832	        elif remaining == 0:
833	            result = FILLED
834	            new_record["remaining"] = 0
835	            new_record["status"] = FILLED
836	        else:
837	            # The replacement is a fresh GTC arrival and always rests.
838	            result = PARTIALLY_FILLED_RESTING if trades else REPLACED
839	            new_record["remaining"] = remaining
840	            new_record["status"] = RESTING
841	            self._rest(
842	                order_id, side, price, remaining,
843	                display_quantity if is_iceberg else None, new_record,
844	            )
845	
846	        # The order id stays occupied: the replacement keeps it and no later
847	        # ADD may reuse it.
848	        self._orders[order_id] = new_record
849	        return event_id, result, None, trades, stp
850	
851	    def _cancel(
852	        self, event_id: str, order_id: str
853	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]]]:
854	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
855	        if record is None or record["status"] != RESTING:
856	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, []
857	
858	        self._remove_from_book(order_id, record)
859	        record["status"] = CANCELLED
860	        record["remaining"] = 0
861	        return event_id, CANCELLED, None, []

863	    def _execution_report(
864	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
865	    ) -> tuple[
866	        str, str, str | None,
867	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
868	    ]:
869	        """Answer a cumulative execution query without touching any state.
870	
871	        Every trade the order ever took part in is attributed to its original
872	        ``order_id``: replacements keep the id and iceberg replenishment slices
873	        trade under the same maker id, so the journal lookup alone gathers the
874	        full history, whether the order acted as maker or taker.
875	        """
876	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
877	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
878	        if record is None:
879	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, [], None, None
880	
881	        side: str = record["side"]
882	        status: str = record["status"]
883	        # A resting order's remaining total includes the iceberg reserve; a
884	        # finished order has nothing open.
885	        open_quantity = record["remaining"] if status == RESTING else 0
886	
887	        attribution: list[dict[str, object]] = []
888	        filled_quantity = 0
889	        executed_notional = 0
890	        for trade in self._trade_log:
891	            if trade["maker_order_id"] == order_id:
892	                role = MAKER
893	                counterparty = trade["taker_order_id"]
894	            elif trade["taker_order_id"] == order_id:
895	                role = TAKER
896	                counterparty = trade["maker_order_id"]
897	            else:
898	                continue
899	            filled_quantity += trade["quantity"]
900	            executed_notional += trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
901	            attribution.append(
902	                {
903	                    "trade_id": trade["trade_id"],
904	                    "role": role,
905	                    "counterparty_order_id": counterparty,
906	                    "event_id": trade["event_id"],
907	                    "price": trade["price"],
908	                    "quantity": trade["quantity"],
909	                }
910	            )
911	
912	        if filled_quantity:
913	            vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
914	                "numerator": executed_notional,
915	                "denominator": filled_quantity,
916	            }
917	        else:
918	            vwap = None
919	        benchmark_price: int = obj["benchmark_price"]
920	        slippage = executed_notional - benchmark_price * filled_quantity
921	        if side == SELL:
922	            # Mirror the buy formula: negative always means improvement.
923	            slippage = -slippage
924	
925	        analysis: dict[str, object] = {
926	            "side": side,
927	            "current_status": status,
928	            "open_quantity": open_quantity,
929	            "filled_quantity": filled_quantity,
930	            "executed_notional": executed_notional,
931	            "vwap": vwap,
932	            "slippage_notional": slippage,
933	            "trade_attribution": attribution,
934	        }
935	        return event_id, REPORTED, None, [], None, analysis
936	
937	    def _impact_report(
938	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
939	    ) -> tuple[str, str, None, list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object]]:
940	        """Estimate an anonymous MARKET order's execution without any mutation.
941	
942	        The simulation walks the opposite book in strict price-time priority,
943	        trades at maker prices and consumes an iceberg's current visible slice
944	        before any reserve; an exhausted slice with reserve left replenishes at
945	        the tail of its price level, exactly like a real fill. The simulated
946	        order is anonymous and unrestricted, so self-trade prevention never
947	        applies and every visible price level is consumed until the requested
948	        quantity is met or liquidity runs out. It produces no trades and
949	        leaves the book, queues, orders, iceberg slices, trade journal,
950	        accounts and the next trade id untouched.
951	        """
952	        side: str = obj["side"]
953	        requested_quantity: int = obj["quantity"]
954	        benchmark_price: int = obj["benchmark_price"]
955	
956	        fills, executable_quantity, executed_notional = self._simulate_market(
957	            side, requested_quantity
958	        )
959	        unfilled_quantity = requested_quantity - executable_quantity
960	        if executable_quantity:
961	            best_price: int | None = fills[0][0]
962	            vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
963	                "numerator": executed_notional,
964	                "denominator": executable_quantity,
965	            }
966	            # Slippage against the caller's benchmark; impact against the
967	            # pre-query best opposite price. The sell side mirrors the buy
968	            # formula so a negative value always means improvement.
969	            slippage = executed_notional - benchmark_price * executable_quantity
970	            impact = executed_notional - best_price * executable_quantity
971	            if side == SELL:
972	                slippage = -slippage
973	                impact = -impact
974	        else:
975	            best_price = None
976	            vwap = None
977	            slippage = 0
978	            impact = 0
979	
980	        analysis: dict[str, object] = {
981	            "side": side,
982	            "requested_quantity": requested_quantity,
983	            "benchmark_price": benchmark_price,
984	            "executable_quantity": executable_quantity,
985	            "unfilled_quantity": unfilled_quantity,
986	            "executed_notional": executed_notional,
987	            "best_price": best_price,
988	            "vwap": vwap,
989	            "slippage_notional": slippage,
990	            "impact_notional": impact,
991	            "price_breakdown": [
992	                {"price": price, "quantity": quantity}
993	                for price, quantity in fills

998	    def _simulate_market(
999	        self, side: str, quantity: int
1000	    ) -> tuple[list[tuple[int, int]], int, int]:
1001	        """Walk the opposite book as an anonymous market order on a copy.
1002	
1003	        Returns ``(fills, executable_quantity, executed_notional)`` where
1004	        ``fills`` holds one ``(price, quantity)`` entry per simulated fill, in
1005	        simulation order: one entry for each passive visible slice consumed,
1006	        exactly the granularity real trades have (so a replenished iceberg
1007	        contributes several entries, interleaved with same-price makers ahead
1008	        of its tail-replenished slices). Queues, remainders and iceberg slices
1009	        are copied into local structures so the live book stays untouched.
1010	        """
1011	        opposite, _totals = self._opposite(side)
1012	        # A buy takes the lowest asks first; a sell takes the highest bids.
1013	        prices = sorted(opposite, reverse=side == SELL)
1014	        need = quantity
1015	        fills: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
1016	        for price in prices:
1017	            if need == 0:
1018	                break
1019	            sim_remaining: dict[str, int] = {}
1020	            sim_visible: dict[str, int] = {}
1021	            queue: deque[str] = deque()
1022	            for maker_id in opposite[price]:
1023	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
1024	                sim_remaining[maker_id] = maker["remaining"]
1025	                if maker.get("visible") is not None:
1026	                    sim_visible[maker_id] = maker["visible"]
1027	                queue.append(maker_id)
1028	            while queue and need > 0:
1029	                maker_id = queue.popleft()
1030	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
1031	                if maker_id in sim_visible:
1032	                    # A resting iceberg only offers its current slice first.
1033	                    available = sim_visible[maker_id]
1034	                else:
1035	                    available = sim_remaining[maker_id]
1036	                matched = min(need, available)
1037	                need -= matched
1038	                sim_remaining[maker_id] -= matched
1039	                fills.append((price, matched))
1040	                if maker_id in sim_visible:
1041	                    sim_visible[maker_id] -= matched
1042	                    if sim_visible[maker_id] == 0 and sim_remaining[maker_id] > 0:
1043	                        # The replenished slice waits behind every order still
1044	                        # visible at this level, exactly as in a real fill.
1045	                        sim_visible[maker_id] = min(
1046	                            maker["display_quantity"], sim_remaining[maker_id]
1047	                        )
1048	                        queue.append(maker_id)
1049	        executable_quantity = quantity - need
1050	        executed_notional = sum(price * qty for price, qty in fills)
1051	        return fills, executable_quantity, executed_notional

1053	    def knows_account(self, account_id: str) -> bool:
1054	        """Whether an accepted ADD ever named ``account_id``.
1055	
1056	        Orders keep their account however they ended up (resting, filled or
1057	        cancelled); rejected ADDs never reach the account set. Used by the
1058	        multi-symbol replay layer's cross-security portfolio query.
1059	        """
1060	        return account_id in self._accounts

1062	    def account_aggregates(
1063	        self, account_id: str
1064	    ) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
1065	        """Cumulative traded quantities and notionals for one account.
1066	
1067	        Returns ``(buy_quantity, sell_quantity, buy_notional, sell_notional)``
1068	        accumulated from every trade the account's orders took part in as maker
1069	        or taker on this engine's security. Replacements keep the order id and
1070	        its account, and iceberg replenishment slices trade under the same
1071	        maker id, so the journal lookup alone gathers the full history. Orders
1072	        without an ``account_id`` never contribute.
1073	        """
1074	        buy_quantity = 0
1075	        sell_quantity = 0
1076	        buy_notional = 0
1077	        sell_notional = 0
1078	        for trade in self._trade_log:
1079	            for order_key in ("maker_order_id", "taker_order_id"):
1080	                order = self._orders[trade[order_key]]
1081	                if order.get("account_id") != account_id:
1082	                    continue
1083	                notional = trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
1084	                if order["side"] == BUY:
1085	                    buy_quantity += trade["quantity"]
1086	                    buy_notional += notional
1087	                else:
1088	                    sell_quantity += trade["quantity"]
1089	                    sell_notional += notional
1090	        return buy_quantity, sell_quantity, buy_notional, sell_notional

1092	    def _account_report(
1093	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
1094	    ) -> tuple[
1095	        str, str, str | None,
1096	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None,
1097	        dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
1098	    ]:
1099	        """Answer a cumulative account query without touching any state.
1100

1102	        resting or arriving as: replacements keep the order id and its
1103	        account, and iceberg replenishment slices trade under the same maker
1104	        id, so the journal lookup alone gathers the full history. Orders
1105	        without an ``account_id`` never contribute.
1106	        """
1107	        account_id: str = obj["account_id"]
1108	        if not self.knows_account(account_id):
1109	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT, [], None, None, None
1110	
1111	        buy_quantity, sell_quantity, buy_notional, sell_notional = (
1112	            self.account_aggregates(account_id)
1113	        )
1114	
1115	        net_position = buy_quantity - sell_quantity
1116	        if buy_quantity:
1117	            buy_vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
1118	                "numerator": buy_notional,
1119	                "denominator": buy_quantity,
1120	            }
1121	        else:
1122	            buy_vwap = None
1123	        if sell_quantity:
1124	            sell_vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
1125	                "numerator": sell_notional,
1126	                "denominator": sell_quantity,
1127	            }
1128	        else:
1129	            sell_vwap = None
1130	
1131	        mark_price: int = obj["mark_price"]
1132	        analysis: dict[str, object] = {
1133	            "account_id": account_id,
1134	            "mark_price": mark_price,
1135	            "buy_quantity": buy_quantity,
1136	            "sell_quantity": sell_quantity,
1137	            "net_position": net_position,
1138	            "buy_notional": buy_notional,
1139	            "sell_notional": sell_notional,
1140	            "buy_vwap": buy_vwap,
1141	            "sell_vwap": sell_vwap,
1142	            "turnover_notional": buy_notional + sell_notional,
1143	            "risk_exposure": abs(net_position) * mark_price,
1144	            "mark_to_market_pnl": (
1145	                sell_notional - buy_notional + net_position * mark_price
1146	            ),
1147	        }
1148	        return event_id, REPORTED, None, [], None, None, analysis

1150	    def _day_end_reconciliation(
1151	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
1152	    ) -> tuple[
1153	        str, str, str | None,
1154	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None,
1155	        dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
1156	        dict[str, object] | None,
1157	    ]:
1158	        """Compare the cumulative journal against external end-of-day records.
1159	
1160	        Purely read-only: the book, order states, queue priorities, trade
1161	        journal, account set and next trade id are all left untouched. The
1162	        actual side is rebuilt from the same journal the reports use, so
1163	        replacements and iceberg replenishment slices contribute under their
1164	        original order id and inherited account.
1165	        """
1166	        actual_trades: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
1167	        for trade in self._trade_log:
1168	            actual_trades[trade["trade_id"]] = {
1169	                "trade_id": trade["trade_id"],
1170	                "maker_order_id": trade["maker_order_id"],
1171	                "taker_order_id": trade["taker_order_id"],
1172	                "price": trade["price"],
1173	                "quantity": trade["quantity"],
1174	            }
1175	
1176	        # Every account an accepted ADD ever named is part of the actual set,
1177	        # whether or not it traded; cash is sell notional minus buy notional.
1178	        actual_accounts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {
1179	            account_id: {
1180	                "account_id": account_id,
1181	                "net_position": 0,
1182	                "cash_balance": 0,
1183	            }
1184	            for account_id in self._accounts
1185	        }
1186	        for trade in self._trade_log:
1187	            notional = trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
1188	            for order_key in ("maker_order_id", "taker_order_id"):
1189	                order = self._orders[trade[order_key]]
1190	                account_id = order.get("account_id")
1191	                if account_id is None:

1193	                position = actual_accounts[account_id]
1194	                if order["side"] == BUY:
1195	                    position["net_position"] += trade["quantity"]
1196	                    position["cash_balance"] -= notional
1197	                else:
1198	                    position["net_position"] -= trade["quantity"]
1199	                    position["cash_balance"] += notional
1200	
1201	        # The external records are normalized into the same field order the
1202	        # actual side uses, so equal content compares (and serializes) equal.
1203	        expected_trades: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
1204	        for item in obj["expected_trades"]:
1205	            expected_trades[item["trade_id"]] = {
1206	                "trade_id": item["trade_id"],
1207	                "maker_order_id": item["maker_order_id"],
1208	                "taker_order_id": item["taker_order_id"],
1209	                "price": item["price"],
1210	                "quantity": item["quantity"],
1211	            }
1212	        expected_accounts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
1213	        for item in obj["expected_accounts"]:
1214	            expected_accounts[item["account_id"]] = {
1215	                "account_id": item["account_id"],
1216	                "net_position": item["net_position"],
1217	                "cash_balance": item["cash_balance"],
1218	            }
1219	
1220	        trade_breaks = self._reconcile_breaks(expected_trades, actual_trades)

1225	            "account_breaks": account_breaks,

1229	    @staticmethod
1230	    def _reconcile_breaks(
1231	        expected: dict[object, dict[str, object]],
1232	        actual: dict[object, dict[str, object]],
1233	    ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
1234	        """Full outer comparison of two identifier-keyed record sets.
1235	
1236	        Breaks are emitted in ascending identifier order; a record present on
1237	        only one side reports the other side as ``None``.
1238	        """
1239	        breaks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
1240	        for identifier in sorted(expected.keys() | actual.keys()):
1241	            exp = expected.get(identifier)
1242	            act = actual.get(identifier)
1243	            if exp is None:
1244	                reason = MISSING_EXPECTED
1245	            elif act is None:
1246	                reason = MISSING_ACTUAL
1247	            elif exp != act:
1248	                reason = FIELD_MISMATCH
1249	            else:
1250	                continue
1251	            breaks.append(
1252	                {
1253	                    "identifier": identifier,
1254	                    "expected": exp,
1255	                    "actual": act,
1256	                    "reason": reason,
1257	                }
1258	            )
1259	        return breaks

1	"""Deterministic multi-symbol ordered event replay with resumable snapshots.
2	
3	This module adds a new public entry point on top of the baseline single-book
4	:class:`~order_book_engine.engine.Engine`; it never changes the baseline
5	matching rules, priorities, rejection semantics or trade record shapes:
6	
7	* A single public call (:func:`replay_events`) accepts an ordered stream of
8	  order events for one or several securities. Every security keeps its own
9	  sequence counter and its own book; events are applied strictly in input
10	  order, so identical timestamps never reorder anything. The stream covers
11	  the baseline ADD/CANCEL/REPLACE behaviours, resumable TWAP/VWAP parent
12	  orders (TWAP_START/TWAP_SLICE/TWAP_CANCEL/TWAP_REPORT and
13	  VWAP_START/VWAP_SLICE/VWAP_CANCEL/VWAP_REPORT), the read-only
14	  cross-security PORTFOLIO_REPORT query and the intraday PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE
15	  adjustment, which replaces one security's active price-limit interval
16	  (seeded from the static ``price_limits`` configuration) for all
17	  subsequently submitted limit prices; plans never read a wall clock and
18	  are advanced solely by their SLICE events. TWAP slices divide
19	  the total evenly; VWAP slices follow a caller-supplied volume-weight
20	  curve.
21	* Each event is committed individually: a later failure never rolls back an
22	  earlier success, and a failed event leaves no order, trade, counter or book
23	  change behind.
24	* Results are plain JSON-compatible dictionaries serialized from canonical
25	  content (sorted keys, compact separators). Equal inputs always produce
26	  byte-identical output.
27	* A snapshot can be exported after any successful event and later passed back
28	  as the starting point. Snapshots carry a format version, a matching
29	  configuration summary and a SHA-256 digest over their normalized content.
30	  Resumption verifies version, configuration and digest before touching any
31	  state, and continued replay produces trade ids, trade ordering and final
32	  results identical to an uninterrupted one-shot run. Plan progress, reserved
33	  derived order ids and cumulative plan analytics are part of the snapshot.
34	
35	The module never opens files: events and snapshots are received from, and
36	returned to, the caller.
37	"""
38	
39	from __future__ import annotations
40	
41	import copy
42	import hashlib
43	import json
44	from collections import deque

179	def _allocate_slices(total_quantity: int, weights: list[int]) -> list[int]:
180	    """Split ``total_quantity`` across buckets proportionally to ``weights``.
181	
182	    Every bucket receives one unit up front; the remaining units are
183	    distributed in proportion to the weights by integer quotient, and the
184	    units left over by that truncation go one each to the buckets with the
185	    largest division remainder, earlier buckets first on ties. The result
186	    always sums to exactly ``total_quantity``.
187	    """
188	    count = len(weights)
189	    remainder = total_quantity - count
190	    total_weight = sum(weights)
191	    quantities: list[int] = []
192	    residuals: list[int] = []
193	    for weight in weights:
194	        quotient, residual = divmod(remainder * weight, total_weight)
195	        quantities.append(1 + quotient)
196	        residuals.append(residual)
197	    leftover = remainder - (sum(quantities) - count)
198	    by_residual = sorted(range(count), key=lambda i: (-residuals[i], i))
199	    for index in by_residual[:leftover]:
200	        quantities[index] += 1
201	    return quantities

204	def _twap_schema_error(payload: dict[str, object]) -> str | None:
205	    """Structural validation of a TWAP command payload.
206	
207	    Mirrors the baseline contract: any field problem (missing or extra field,
208	    wrong type, a non-positive integer where a positive one is required, an
209	    empty identifier, a LIMIT without a positive price or a MARKET carrying
210	    one, ...) is an ``INVALID_EVENT`` and consumes neither the event id nor the
211	    sequence.
212	    """
213	    event_type = payload["type"]
214	    if event_type == TWAP_START:
215	        keys = set(payload)
216	        if not keys >= _TWAP_START_REQUIRED or not keys <= _TWAP_START_KEYS:
217	            return INVALID_EVENT
218	        if not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("plan_id")):
219	            return INVALID_EVENT
220	        if payload.get("side") not in (BUY, SELL):
221	            return INVALID_EVENT
222	        order_type = payload.get("order_type")
223	        if order_type not in (LIMIT, MARKET):
224	            return INVALID_EVENT
225	        total_quantity = payload.get("total_quantity")
226	        slice_count = payload.get("slice_count")
227	        benchmark_price = payload.get("benchmark_price")
228	        if not _is_positive_int(total_quantity):
229	            return INVALID_EVENT
230	        if not _is_positive_int(slice_count):
231	            return INVALID_EVENT
232	        if total_quantity < slice_count:
233	            return INVALID_EVENT
234	        if not _is_positive_int(benchmark_price):
235	            return INVALID_EVENT
236	        if order_type == LIMIT:
237	            if not _is_positive_int(payload.get("price")):
238	                return INVALID_EVENT
239	        elif "price" in payload and payload["price"] is not None:
240	            # MARKET plans must not carry a non-null price; omission or an
241	            # explicit null is accepted.
242	            return INVALID_EVENT
243	        if "account_id" in payload and not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("account_id")):
244	            return INVALID_EVENT
245	        return None
246	    # TWAP_SLICE / TWAP_CANCEL / TWAP_REPORT are pure plan references.
247	    if set(payload) != _TWAP_PLAN_REF_KEYS:
248	        return INVALID_EVENT
249	    if not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("plan_id")):
250	        return INVALID_EVENT
251	    return None

258	    field, wrong type, a non-positive integer where a positive one is
259	    required, an empty identifier, an empty or non-positive weight, a LIMIT
260	    without a positive price or a MARKET carrying one, ...) is an
261	    ``INVALID_EVENT`` and consumes neither the event id nor the sequence.

264	    if event_type == VWAP_START:
265	        keys = set(payload)

267	            return INVALID_EVENT

269	            return INVALID_EVENT

271	            return INVALID_EVENT
272	        order_type = payload.get("order_type")
273	        if order_type not in (LIMIT, MARKET):
274	            return INVALID_EVENT
275	        total_quantity = payload.get("total_quantity")
276	        volume_weights = payload.get("volume_weights")
277	        benchmark_price = payload.get("benchmark_price")

300	            return INVALID_EVENT

310	def _portfolio_report_schema_error(payload: dict[str, object]) -> str | None:
311	    """Structural validation of a PORTFOLIO_REPORT query payload.
312	
313	    The query carries exactly ``event_id``, ``type``, ``account_id`` and
314	    ``mark_prices``; identifiers are non-empty strings and ``mark_prices`` is
315	    an object mapping non-empty symbol strings to positive integers (booleans
316	    do not count). The map may be empty structurally: for a known account it
317	    can never match that account's securities, so the empty map is classified
318	    as ``MARK_PRICE_MISMATCH`` (which consumes the id and the sequence) rather
319	    than as a schema error. Whether the account is known and whether the key
320	    set actually covers its securities are therefore business checks, not
321	    schema checks: an INVALID_EVENT consumes neither the event id nor the
322	    sequence, while the business rejections do.
323	    """
324	    if set(payload) != _PORTFOLIO_REPORT_KEYS:
325	        return INVALID_EVENT
326	    if not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("account_id")):
327	        return INVALID_EVENT
328	    mark_prices = payload.get("mark_prices")
329	    if not isinstance(mark_prices, dict):
330	        return INVALID_EVENT
331	    for symbol, mark_price in mark_prices.items():
332	        if not _is_non_empty_str(symbol):
333	            return INVALID_EVENT
334	        if not _is_positive_int(mark_price):
335	            return INVALID_EVENT
336	    return None

340	    """Structural validation of a PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE command payload.
341	
342	    The command carries exactly ``event_id``, ``type``, ``lower_price`` and
343	    ``upper_price``; both bounds are positive integers (booleans do not
344	    count) with ``lower_price <= upper_price``. Any field problem is an

354	        return INVALID_EVENT

375	def _price_limit_error(price_limits: object) -> str | None:
376	    """Validate the optional static ``price_limits`` configuration block.
377	
378	    The block maps each configured security name (a non-empty string) to an
379	    object holding exactly ``lower`` and ``upper``; both bounds are positive
380	    integers (booleans do not count) with ``lower <= upper``. An empty block
381	    (or an absent one) leaves every security at the baseline behaviour.
382	    Returns an error message when the block is malformed, otherwise ``None``.
383	    """
384	    if not isinstance(price_limits, dict):
385	        return "price_limits must be an object mapping symbols to bounds"
386	    for symbol, bounds in price_limits.items():
387	        if not _is_non_empty_str(symbol):
388	            return "price_limits keys must be non-empty symbol strings"
389	        if not isinstance(bounds, dict) or set(bounds) != {"lower", "upper"}:
390	            return (
391	                f"price_limits for {symbol!r} must be an object with exactly "
392	                "'lower' and 'upper'"
393	            )
394	        lower = bounds["lower"]
395	        upper = bounds["upper"]
396	        if not _is_positive_int(lower) or not _is_positive_int(upper):
397	            return f"price_limits for {symbol!r} must use positive integer bounds"
398	        if lower > upper:
399	            return f"price_limits for {symbol!r} require lower <= upper"
400	    return None

405	    if "price_limits" in config:
406	        message = _price_limit_error(config["price_limits"])
407	        if message is not None:

416	def canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
417	    """Serialize JSON content deterministically.
418	
419	    Object keys are sorted, separators are compact and no ASCII escaping is
420	    applied. Integers stay as exact JSON integers; only JSON-native content is
421	    accepted (the module never produces floats or other lossy types).
422	    """
423	    return json.dumps(
424	        value,
425	        ensure_ascii=False,
426	        sort_keys=True,
427	        separators=(",", ":"),
428	        allow_nan=False,
429	    ).encode("utf-8")
430	
431	
432	def _digest(value: object) -> str:
433	    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(value)).hexdigest()

458	class ExecutionPlan:
459	    """Mutable state of one resumable TWAP or VWAP parent order on one security.
460	
461	    All cumulative analytics (filled quantity, notional, cancelled quantity)
462	    are maintained incrementally, so a snapshot carries exactly the state a
463	    continued or resumed slice needs. Slice quantities are fixed at creation:
464	    a TWAP plan divides the total evenly across ``slice_count`` slices and
465	    spreads the division remainder as one extra unit over the earliest
466	    slices, while a VWAP plan allocates one unit per bucket up front and
467	    distributes the rest proportionally to its volume weights (see
468	    :func:`_allocate_slices`).
469	    """
470	
471	    __slots__ = (
472	        "plan_id", "side", "order_type", "benchmark_price", "price",
473	        "account_id", "algorithm", "volume_weights", "slice_quantities",
474	        "released", "released_quantity", "filled_quantity",
475	        "cancelled_quantity", "notional", "status",
476	    )
477	
478	    def __init__(
479	        self,
480	        plan_id: str,
481	        side: str,
482	        order_type: str,
483	        total_quantity: int,
484	        slice_count: int,
485	        benchmark_price: int,
486	        price: int | None,
487	        account_id: str | None,
488	        *,
489	        algorithm: str = ALGORITHM_TWAP,
490	        volume_weights: list[int] | None = None,
491	    ) -> None:
492	        self.plan_id = plan_id
493	        self.side = side
494	        self.order_type = order_type
495	        self.benchmark_price = benchmark_price
496	        self.price = price
497	        self.account_id = account_id
498	        self.algorithm = algorithm
499	        self.volume_weights = list(volume_weights) if volume_weights is not None else None
500	        if algorithm == ALGORITHM_VWAP:
501	            self.slice_quantities: list[int] = _allocate_slices(
502	                total_quantity, self.volume_weights
503	            )
504	        else:
505	            base, extra = divmod(total_quantity, slice_count)
506	            self.slice_quantities = [
507	                base + (1 if index < extra else 0)
508	                for index in range(slice_count)
509	            ]
510	        # Number of slices already released; also the index of the next one.
511	        self.released = 0
512	        self.released_quantity = 0
513	        self.filled_quantity = 0
514	        self.cancelled_quantity = 0
515	        self.notional = 0
516	        self.status = PLAN_ACTIVE
517	
518	    @property
519	    def slice_count(self) -> int:
520	        return len(self.slice_quantities)
521	
522	    @property
523	    def total_quantity(self) -> int:
524	        return sum(self.slice_quantities)
525	
526	    @property
527	    def remaining_slices(self) -> int:
528	        if self.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
529	            return 0
530	        return self.slice_count - self.released
531	
532	    def child_order_id(self, slice_number: int) -> str:
533	        """The deterministic derived order id of slice ``slice_number``.
534	
535	        Slice numbers are 1-based and joined with ``#``; the scheme is fixed,
536	        so the same input stream always derives the same identifiers.
537	        """
538	        return f"{self.plan_id}#{slice_number}"
539	
540	    def child_ids(self) -> list[str]:
541	        return [self.child_order_id(i + 1) for i in range(self.slice_count)]
542	
543	    def summary(
544	        self,
545	        *,
546	        slice_number: int | None = None,
547	        child_order_id: str | None = None,
548	        target_weight: int | None = None,
549	        scheduled_quantity: int | None = None,
550	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
551	        """Build the ``execution_plan`` object echoed by plan responses."""
552	        vwap = (
553	            {"numerator": self.notional, "denominator": self.filled_quantity}
554	            if self.filled_quantity
555	            else None
556	        )
557	        slippage = self.notional - self.benchmark_price * self.filled_quantity
558	        if self.side == SELL:
559	            # Mirror the buy formula: negative always means improvement.
560	            slippage = -slippage
561	        plan: dict[str, object] = {
562	            "status": self.status,
563	            "released_quantity": self.released_quantity,
564	            "filled_quantity": self.filled_quantity,
565	            "cancelled_quantity": self.cancelled_quantity,
566	            "remaining_slices": self.remaining_slices,
567	            "executed_notional": self.notional,
568	            "vwap": vwap,
569	            "slippage_notional": slippage,
570	        }
571	        if self.algorithm == ALGORITHM_VWAP:
572	            plan["algorithm"] = ALGORITHM_VWAP
573	        if slice_number is not None:
574	            plan["slice_number"] = slice_number
575	        if child_order_id is not None:
576	            plan["child_order_id"] = child_order_id
577	        if target_weight is not None:
578	            plan["target_weight"] = target_weight
579	        if scheduled_quantity is not None:
580	            plan["scheduled_quantity"] = scheduled_quantity
581	        return plan
582	
583	    def to_json(self) -> dict[str, object]:
584	        """Serialize the complete plan state for a snapshot."""
585	        data: dict[str, object] = {
586	            "plan_id": self.plan_id,
587	            "side": self.side,
588	            "order_type": self.order_type,
589	            "benchmark_price": self.benchmark_price,
590	            "price": self.price,
591	            "account_id": self.account_id,
592	            "slice_quantities": list(self.slice_quantities),
593	            "released": self.released,
594	            "released_quantity": self.released_quantity,
595	            "filled_quantity": self.filled_quantity,
596	            "cancelled_quantity": self.cancelled_quantity,
597	            "notional": self.notional,
598	            "status": self.status,
599	        }
600	        if self.algorithm == ALGORITHM_VWAP:
601	            # TWAP records keep their historical shape; VWAP records add the
602	            # algorithm label and the schedule the allocation derives from.
603	            data["algorithm"] = ALGORITHM_VWAP
604	            data["volume_weights"] = list(self.volume_weights)
605	        return data

628	class EventReplayer:
629	    """Stateful, resumable multi-symbol replay session.
630	
631	    One session binds together the per-symbol books, per-symbol sequence
632	    counters, the global idempotency log and the matching configuration.
633	    Instances are normally obtained from :func:`replay_events` or restored via
634	    :func:`restore_replayer`; they are not thread safe on purpose.
635	    """
636	
637	    def __init__(self, config: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> None:
638	        if config is not None and not isinstance(config, dict):
639	            raise TypeError("config must be a JSON object or None")
640	        self.config: dict[str, object] = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG if config is None else config)
641	        _validate_config(self.config)
642	        # Static per-security price bounds (closed interval), parsed from the
643	        # validated config. They seed each security's *active* interval (and
644	        # a legacy snapshot's restored one); accepted PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE
645	        # events then replace the active interval per security. Securities
646	        # without an entry start unlimited.
647	        raw_limits = self.config.get("price_limits") or {}
648	        self.price_limits: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {
649	            symbol: (bounds["lower"], bounds["upper"])
650	            for symbol, bounds in raw_limits.items()
651	        }
652	        self.config_digest = _digest(self.config)
653	        self._symbols: dict[str, _SymbolState] = {}
654	        # Global index of every accepted eventId: eventId -> (symbol, content).
655	        self._events: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
656	
657	    # -- book helpers -------------------------------------------------------
658	
659	    def book(self, symbol: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, int]], list[dict[str, int]]]:
660	        """The final ``(bids, asks)`` aggregates for one security."""
661	        state = self._symbols.get(symbol)
662	        if state is None:
663	            return [], []
664	        return state.engine.snapshot()
665	
666	    # -- main entry ---------------------------------------------------------
667	
668	    def submit(self, events: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
669	        """Apply an ordered list of event objects, one result per event."""
670	        return [self._submit_one(event) for event in events]
671	
672	    def _book_changes(
673	        self,
674	        engine: Engine,
675	        before_bids: dict[int, int],
676	        before_asks: dict[int, int],
677	    ) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, int]]]:
678	        bid_totals, ask_totals = engine.level_totals()
679	        bid_changes: list[dict[str, int]] = []
680	        for price in sorted(set(before_bids) | set(bid_totals), reverse=True):
681	            new_qty = bid_totals.get(price, 0)
682	            if before_bids.get(price, 0) != new_qty:
683	                bid_changes.append({"price": price, "quantity": new_qty})

685	        for price in sorted(set(before_asks) | set(ask_totals)):
686	            new_qty = ask_totals.get(price, 0)
687	            if before_asks.get(price, 0) != new_qty:

689	        return {"bids": bid_changes, "asks": ask_changes}

691	    @staticmethod
692	    def _invalid(
693	        event: object,
694	        code: str = INVALID_EVENT,
695	        *,
696	        expected_sequence: int | None = None,
697	        state: _SymbolState | None = None,
698	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
699	        event_id = symbol = None
700	        sequence = None
701	        if isinstance(event, dict):
702	            eid = event.get("event_id")
703	            if isinstance(eid, str) and eid != "":
704	                event_id = eid
705	            sym = event.get("symbol")
706	            if isinstance(sym, str) and sym != "":
707	                symbol = sym
708	            seq = event.get("sequence")
709	            if isinstance(seq, int) and not isinstance(seq, bool):
710	                sequence = seq
711	        result: dict[str, object] = {
712	            "event_id": event_id,
713	            "symbol": symbol,
714	            "sequence": sequence,
715	            "status": REJECTED,
716	            "rejection_code": code,
717	        }

719	            result["expected_sequence"] = expected_sequence
720	        result["trades"] = []

727	        else:

733	    def _submit_one(self, event: object) -> dict[str, object]:
734	        # ---- envelope validation (nothing is consumed on failure) --------
735	        if not isinstance(event, dict):
736	            return self._invalid(event)
737	        event_id = event.get("event_id")
738	        symbol = event.get("symbol")
739	        sequence = event.get("sequence")
740	        timestamp = event.get("timestamp")
741	        valid_envelope_ids = (
742	            isinstance(event_id, str)
743	            and event_id != ""
744	            and isinstance(symbol, str)
745	            and symbol != ""
746	            and isinstance(sequence, int)
747	            and not isinstance(sequence, bool)
748	            and sequence > 0
749	        )
750	        if not valid_envelope_ids:
751	            # The symbol cannot be trusted yet, so no book is echoed and no
752	            # symbol state is created.
753	            return self._invalid(event)
754	
755	        def reject_envelope(code: str = INVALID_EVENT) -> dict[str, object]:
756	            # A structurally invalid event for a recognizable symbol echoes the
757	            # untouched book but never mutates or registers anything.
758	            return self._invalid(event, code, state=self._symbols.get(symbol))
759	
760	        if "timestamp" in event and not _valid_timestamp(timestamp):
761	            return reject_envelope()
762	
763	        # The baseline payload is either nested under "event" or carried
764	        # inline alongside the envelope fields.
765	        if "event" in event:
766	            nested = event["event"]
767	            envelope_keys = _ENVELOPE_KEYS | {"event"}
768	            if not isinstance(nested, dict):
769	                return reject_envelope()
770	            payload: dict[str, object] = nested
771	            # The wrapper may only carry envelope fields plus the payload.
772	            if not set(event) <= envelope_keys:
773	                return reject_envelope()
774	        else:
775	            # The inline form may carry envelope fields plus exactly the fields
776	            # of its own payload kind.
777	            allowed_payload_keys = self._allowed_payload_keys(event.get("type"))
778	            if allowed_payload_keys is None or not set(event) <= (
779	                _ENVELOPE_KEYS | allowed_payload_keys
780	            ):
781	                return reject_envelope()
782	            # Keep event_id/type (payload fields); strip only symbol,
783	            # sequence and timestamp, which are envelope-only.
784	            payload = {
785	                key: value
786	                for key, value in event.items()
787	                if key not in ("symbol", "sequence", "timestamp")
788	            }
789	        event_type = payload.get("type")
790	        if not isinstance(event_type, str) or event_type not in SUPPORTED_TYPES:
791	            return reject_envelope()
792	        # Validate the full payload schema up front, so malformed content is
793	        # classified INVALID_EVENT and reaches neither ordering nor the book.
794	        # The wrapper and the payload must identify the same event.
795	        if payload.get("event_id") != event_id:
796	            return reject_envelope()
797	        if event_type in _TWAP_TYPES:
798	            schema_error = _twap_schema_error(payload)
799	        elif event_type in _VWAP_TYPES:
800	            schema_error = _vwap_schema_error(payload)
801	        elif event_type == PORTFOLIO_REPORT:
802	            schema_error = _portfolio_report_schema_error(payload)
803	        elif event_type == PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE:
804	            schema_error = _price_limit_update_schema_error(payload)
805	        else:
806	            schema_error = Engine._schema_error(payload)
807	        if schema_error is not None:
808	            return reject_envelope()
809	
810	        # A symbol state is created only once the event is fully well formed;
811	        # failures that precede dispatch must not register an empty book.
812	        state = self._symbols.get(symbol)
813	        known_symbol = state is not None
814	        if state is None:
815	            state = _SymbolState()
816	            # The active interval starts at the static configuration; an
817	            # accepted PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE replaces it from then on.
818	            state.price_limits = self.price_limits.get(symbol)
819	
820	        # ---- global idempotency (checked before sequencing) --------------
821	        # A retried delivery carries its original, now-stale sequence; it must
822	        # still be recognized as a duplicate rather than as out-of-order.
823	        content = canonical_json(payload).decode("utf-8")

825	        if prior is not None:
826	            prior_symbol, prior_content = prior
827	            if prior_symbol == symbol and prior_content == content:
828	                bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()

830	                    "event_id": event_id,
831	                    "symbol": symbol,
832	                    "sequence": sequence,
833	                    "status": DUPLICATE,
834	                    "trades": [],
835	                    "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
836	                    "bids": bids,
837	                    "asks": asks,
838	                }

840	            # conflict consumes neither sequence nor book state, so the

843	                event, EVENT_ID_CONFLICT,
844	                expected_sequence=state.last_sequence + 1 if known_symbol else None,
845	                state=state if known_symbol else None,
846	            )
847	
848	        # ---- per-symbol strict sequence ordering -------------------------
849	        expected = state.last_sequence + 1
850	        if sequence < expected or sequence > expected:
851	            code = OUT_OF_ORDER if sequence < expected else SEQUENCE_GAP
852	            return self._invalid(
853	                event, code, expected_sequence=expected,
854	                state=state if known_symbol else None,
855	            )
856	
857	        # ---- committed application ---------------------------------------
858	        # From here on the event is dispatched: register a brand new symbol
859	        # book and commit id/sequence exactly as the baseline does.
860	        if not known_symbol:
861	            self._symbols[symbol] = state
862	
863	        # A derived child id (``plan_id#slice``) is reserved from plan start;
864	        # it occupies both the order-id and event-id role of the future child,
865	        # so no external event — baseline or TWAP command — may reuse it as an
866	        # event id.
867	        if event_id in state.plan_index:
868	            # Committed like every baseline business rejection: the well-formed
869	            # event occupies its id and the sequence, but nothing else moves.
870	            state.last_sequence = sequence
871	            state.seen[event_id] = content
872	            self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
873	            bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
874	            return {
875	                "event_id": event_id,
876	                "symbol": symbol,
877	                "sequence": sequence,
878	                "status": REJECTED,
879	                "rejection_code": DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID,
880	                "trades": [],
881	                "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
882	                "bids": bids,
883	                "asks": asks,
884	            }
885	
886	        # ---- active per-security price limits ---------------------------
887	        # Enforced after the envelope, idempotency, sequence and identifier
888	        # conflict checks, and strictly before matching or any state change.
889	        # The identifier clashes the baseline engine would reach first (a
890	        # reused order id, a replace against a missing order, a duplicate plan
891	        # or a clashing derived id) keep their rejection-code precedence; a
892	        # price breach is only reported when none applies. The interval tested

894	        # last replaced by any accepted PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE.
895	        price_rejection = self._price_limit_rejection(payload, event_type, state)
896	        if price_rejection is not None:
897	            # A committed business rejection: it occupies the event id and
898	            # advances the symbol sequence, but performs no matching, leaves
899	            # no order or plan behind and spends no trade id. Baseline event
900	            # ids also occupy the per-symbol engine journal, exactly as an
901	            # engine-side business rejection would; plan commands live solely
902	            # in the replay log.
903	            state.last_sequence = sequence
904	            state.seen[event_id] = content
905	            self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
906	            if event_type not in _PLAN_TYPES:
907	                state.engine.occupy_event_id(event_id)
908	            bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
909	            return {
910	                "event_id": event_id,
911	                "symbol": symbol,
912	                "sequence": sequence,
913	                "status": REJECTED,
914	                "rejection_code": price_rejection,
915	                "trades": [],
916	                "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
917	                "bids": bids,
918	                "asks": asks,
919	            }
920	
921	        if event_type == PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE:
922	            return self._dispatch_price_limit_update(
923	                event_id, payload, state, symbol, sequence, content
924	            )
925	
926	        if event_type == PORTFOLIO_REPORT:
927	            return self._dispatch_portfolio_report(
928	                event_id, payload, state, symbol, sequence, content
929	            )
930	
931	        if event_type in _PLAN_TYPES:
932	            out = self._dispatch_plan(
933	                event, payload, event_type, state, symbol, sequence, content
934	            )
935	            return out
936	
937	        before_bids, before_asks = state.engine.level_totals()
938	        before_bids = dict(before_bids)
939	        before_asks = dict(before_asks)
940	        _eid, engine_result, reason, trades, _stp, _analysis, _position = (
941	            state.engine.handle_object_position(payload)
942	        )
943	
944	        # Dispatched: the well-formed event occupies its id however the
945	        # business outcome ends, and the symbol's sequence advances exactly as
946	        # the input did. This mirrors the baseline's id-occupancy rule.
947	        state.last_sequence = sequence
948	        state.seen[event_id] = content
949	        self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
950	
951	        bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
952	        book_changes = self._book_changes(state.engine, before_bids, before_asks)
953	        if reason is None:
954	            out: dict[str, object] = {
955	                "event_id": event_id,
956	                "symbol": symbol,
957	                "sequence": sequence,
958	                "status": ACCEPTED,
959	                "result": engine_result,
960	                "trades": trades,
961	                "book_changes": book_changes,
962	                "bids": bids,
963	                "asks": asks,
964	            }
965	        else:
966	            out = {
967	                "event_id": event_id,
968	                "symbol": symbol,
969	                "sequence": sequence,
970	                "status": REJECTED,
971	                # Baseline business rejection codes (UNKNOWN_ORDER,
972	                # DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, ...) are preserved verbatim.
973	                "rejection_code": reason,
974	                "trades": trades,
975	                "book_changes": book_changes,
976	                "bids": bids,
977	                "asks": asks,

981	    def _price_limit_rejection(
982	        self,
983	        payload: dict[str, object],
984	        event_type: str,
985	        state: _SymbolState,
986	    ) -> str | None:
987	        """Decide a price-limit breach against the active interval.
988	
989	        Only the price of a LIMIT/ICEBERG ADD, of a REPLACE and of a LIMIT
990	        TWAP/VWAP plan is tested against the security's currently active
991	        closed interval (the static config interval as replaced by accepted
992	        PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE events); MARKET orders and MARKET plans are
993	        exempt. Identifier clashes the baseline reaches first keep precedence
994	        and are reported as ``None`` here: a reused order id, a replace
995	        against a non-resting target, a duplicate plan id or a clash over a
996	        derived child id.
997	        """
998	        bounds = state.price_limits
999	        if bounds is None:
1000	            return None
1001	        lower, upper = bounds
1002	
1003	        def out_of_bounds(price: int) -> bool:
1004	            return price < lower or price > upper
1005	
1006	        if event_type == ADD:
1007	            order_type = payload["order_type"]
1008	            if order_type not in (LIMIT, ICEBERG):
1009	                return None
1010	            order_id: str = payload["order_id"]
1011	            if state.engine.has_order_id(order_id):
1012	                # The engine would reject DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID first.
1013	                return None
1014	            return PRICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED if out_of_bounds(payload["price"]) else None
1015	
1016	        if event_type == REPLACE:
1017	            order_id = payload["order_id"]
1018	            target_kind = state.engine.replace_target_kind(order_id)
1019	            if target_kind is None:
1020	                # A missing or finished target yields UNKNOWN_ORDER first.
1021	                return None
1022	            if target_kind == "plain" and "display_quantity" in payload:
1023	                # The engine rejects this pre-commit with INVALID_SCHEMA; it
1024	                # must keep precedence and consume neither id nor sequence.
1025	                return None
1026	            return PRICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED if out_of_bounds(payload["price"]) else None
1027	
1028	        if event_type in (TWAP_START, VWAP_START):
1029	            if payload["order_type"] != LIMIT:
1030	                # MARKET plans are exempt, exactly like MARKET orders.
1031	                return None
1032	            plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
1033	            if plan_id in state.plans:
1034	                # Mirror _register_plan: the plan id clash wins.
1035	                return None
1036	            if event_type == TWAP_START:
1037	                child_count: int = payload["slice_count"]
1038	            else:
1039	                child_count = len(payload["volume_weights"])
1040	            for index in range(child_count):
1041	                child_id = f"{plan_id}#{index + 1}"
1042	                if state.engine.has_order_id(child_id) or child_id in state.plan_index:
1043	                    # A derived id clash rejects DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID first.
1044	                    return None
1045	            return PRICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED if out_of_bounds(payload["price"]) else None
1046	
1047	        return None

1049	    @staticmethod
1050	    def _allowed_payload_keys(inline_type: object) -> frozenset[str] | None:
1051	        """The payload fields an inline event of ``inline_type`` may carry."""
1052	        if inline_type in (ADD, CANCEL, REPLACE):
1053	            return _BASELINE_KEYS
1054	        if inline_type == TWAP_START:
1055	            return _TWAP_START_KEYS
1056	        if inline_type == VWAP_START:
1057	            return _VWAP_START_KEYS
1058	        if inline_type in (TWAP_SLICE, TWAP_CANCEL, TWAP_REPORT,
1059	                           VWAP_SLICE, VWAP_CANCEL, VWAP_REPORT):
1060	            return _TWAP_PLAN_REF_KEYS
1061	        if inline_type == PORTFOLIO_REPORT:
1062	            return _PORTFOLIO_REPORT_KEYS
1063	        if inline_type == PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE:
1064	            return _PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE_KEYS
1065	        return None

1069	    def _dispatch_plan(
1070	        self,
1071	        event: dict[str, object],
1072	        payload: dict[str, object],
1073	        event_type: str,
1074	        state: _SymbolState,
1075	        symbol: str,
1076	        sequence: int,
1077	        content: str,
1078	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
1079	        """Dispatch a structurally valid, in-sequence parent-order command.
1080	
1081	        Every branch commits the well-formed event id and advances the symbol
1082	        sequence, including business rejections: this matches the baseline
1083	        rule that a valid event occupies its id whatever the business result.
1084	        """
1085	        event_id: str = event["event_id"]
1086	
1087	        before_bids, before_asks = state.engine.level_totals()
1088	        before_bids = dict(before_bids)
1089	        before_asks = dict(before_asks)
1090	
1091	        if event_type == TWAP_START:
1092	            result_out = self._twap_start(payload, state)
1093	        elif event_type == VWAP_START:
1094	            result_out = self._vwap_start(payload, state)
1095	        elif event_type in (TWAP_SLICE, VWAP_SLICE):
1096	            result_out = self._plan_slice(payload, state)
1097	        elif event_type in (TWAP_CANCEL, VWAP_CANCEL):
1098	            result_out = self._plan_cancel(payload, state)
1099	        else:
1100	            result_out = self._plan_report(payload, state)
1101	
1102	        # The structurally valid command occupies its event id and the symbol
1103	        # sequence whatever its business outcome.
1104	        state.last_sequence = sequence
1105	        state.seen[event_id] = content
1106	        self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
1107	
1108	        # Only a released slice can move the book; compute the change set with
1109	        # the same level-diff routine the baseline path uses, so drained
1110	        # levels and iceberg replenishment are reported identically.
1111	        book_changes = self._book_changes(state.engine, before_bids, before_asks)
1112	        return self._plan_response(
1113	            event_id, symbol, sequence, state, result_out, book_changes
1114	        )

1151	    @staticmethod
1152	    def _register_plan(
1153	        state: _SymbolState, plan: ExecutionPlan
1154	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, None]:
1155	        """Register a new plan and reserve its derived ids.
1156	
1157	        TWAP and VWAP plans share the per-symbol ``plan_id`` namespace, so a
1158	        duplicate id rejects whatever algorithm started the existing plan.
1159	        Every derived id is reserved up front; a clash with an existing order
1160	        or another plan's derived id rejects the start before anything is
1161	        registered, so the event leaves no plan or reservation behind.
1162	        """
1163	        plan_id = plan.plan_id
1164	        if plan_id in state.plans:
1165	            return REJECTED, DUPLICATE_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
1166	        for child_id in plan.child_ids():
1167	            if state.engine.has_order_id(child_id) or child_id in state.plan_index:
1168	                return REJECTED, DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, None, None
1169	        for child_id in plan.child_ids():
1170	            state.engine.reserve_order_id(child_id)
1171	            state.plan_index[child_id] = plan_id
1172	        state.plans[plan_id] = plan
1173	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, None

1175	    def _plan_slice(
1176	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
1177	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, dict[str, object] | None]:
1178	        """Release the next slice as an IOC child order against current book."""
1179	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
1180	        plan = state.plans.get(plan_id)
1181	        if plan is None:
1182	            return REJECTED, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
1183	        if plan.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
1184	            return REJECTED, EXECUTION_PLAN_CLOSED, None, None
1185	
1186	        # A LIMIT plan started inside the band is re-checked against the
1187	        # *current* active interval before every release: an intraday
1188	        # PRICE_LIMIT_UPDATE may have moved the band since the start. A
1189	        # breach rejects the SLICE without advancing the slice number or any
1190	        # cumulative counter, and the reserved derived ids stay reserved.
1191	        if plan.order_type == LIMIT and state.price_limits is not None:
1192	            lower, upper = state.price_limits
1193	            if plan.price < lower or plan.price > upper:
1194	                return REJECTED, PRICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, None, None
1195	
1196	        slice_number = plan.released + 1
1197	        child_id = plan.child_order_id(slice_number)
1198	        quantity = plan.slice_quantities[plan.released]
1199	
1200	        child: dict[str, object] = {
1201	            "event_id": child_id,
1202	            "type": ADD,
1203	            "order_id": child_id,
1204	            "side": plan.side,
1205	            "order_type": plan.order_type,
1206	            "quantity": quantity,
1207	            "time_in_force": IOC,
1208	        }
1209	        if plan.order_type == LIMIT:
1210	            child["price"] = plan.price
1211	        if plan.account_id is not None:
1212	            child["account_id"] = plan.account_id
1213	
1214	        # The child id was reserved at plan start; release it immediately
